results.label: a session recorded yesterday is not counted, quoted or carried into today
the payload names the server’s own UTC day and never the caller’s
a caller cannot scope, re-date or re-timezone the answer: extras in the body change nothing
the record itself is untouched: the practice surface still counts it on the day it was made
the gate answers, the intention and the routine cycle are all reported as records, each with its own recorded timestamp
two days later the same question reports no session and no same-day intention, and quotes the gate record with its own age instead of claiming it is today’s
the routine cycle is still reported as the stored cycle it is, carrying its own date, instead of being refreshed into today
asking across a day boundary creates no cycle, no reset and no new row of any kind
the calendar surface refuses to translate unknown into a pass on every day
the records surface never turns counts into a streak, a target or a score
reading the same surfaces on two different days still writes nothing at all

scope: M109 day policy and UTC boundaries: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM on literal journals, fixedUTC; deterministic read-only advisory channel, no model/network/provider/broker/mental-state/pixel/production proof
